rows.behavior: The hermes Dockerfile builds FROM nousresearch/hermes-agent:v0.23.4, runs the faster-whisper install with /opt/hermes/tools/uv-0.13.5-linux-arm64/uv, still copies the OpenViking plugin 2.1.1 at pin 9f150ece and the openviking_tools wrapper, installs jq but not chromium, and hermes_version in deployments/applications/services.tf is 0.23.4-1.
rows.fails_when: the base is any other tag, the uv path names another version, the plugin pin or wrapper copy changes, chromium is still installed or jq is not, or the tag is not 0.23.4-1

rows.behavior: No skill or SOUL.md under deployments/applications/services/hermes names a browser tool v0.23.0 removed (browser_navigate, browser_snapshot, browser_click and the rest of the old browser_* set), and medium-reader browses with browser_exec.
rows.fails_when: any removed browser_* tool name appears under deployments/applications/services/hermes, or medium-reader does not name browser_exec
rows.command: uv run --directory cli pytest tests/test_hermes_version.py -q -k browser

rows.behavior: Before the apply, state.db is copied off the hermes_data volume on radxa, and the copy's location is recorded in the review, because v0.23.3 moves its schema from 31 to 33.
rows.fails_when: no copy is taken before the apply, or its location is not recorded

rows.behavior: After the apply, the hermes job's new deployment is healthy on ghcr.io/jasperhg90/hermes:0.23.4-1; the gateway log shows openviking_tools loaded; a viking_search through 127.0.0.1:1934 returns account lab memories; a Telegram voice note is transcribed; medium-reader loads a Medium article through browser_exec; /cron list shows the jobs from register-cron.sh; and the dashboard OIDC login through hermes-gateway works.
rows.fails_when: any of those fails, or its evidence is not recorded in the review

rows.behavior: .okf/components/hermes.md names v0.23.4 and the image's current contents (no chromium, uv 0.13.5), and the Dockerfile comments no longer cite agent-browser or 'Checked against v0.22.2'.
